title: Made an air hockey game in Dracula's Castle
author: Thomas-Lore

comments.author: Thomas-Lore
comments.body:
I am an old timer, I used to make mobile games so I am used to the hate. I jumped on the AI wagon quite soon and have a ton of fun with it (my thesis was on neural networks, but that was like 20 years ago and we had no compute back then to do anything interesting with them, I am old).  
  
I was trying to make the Shufflepuck Cafe style game for a while now, finally got to it. Music is composed by me, graphics and coding is all claude&codex. (Logo is in Inkscape and I just noticed some of the lines shifted, will fix that ASAP.)

comments.author: Thomas-Lore
comments.body: I know, I rushed it a bit before Halloween. :)
